description: Level 1 raw spectral data - continuous (profile) imzML acquisition annotations. The paired .ibd binary is an unannotated companion carrying only CoreFileAttributes.

ACQUISITION_INSTRUMENT_MODEL.description: Specific instrument model (e.g., timsTOF Flex, Q Exactive).

ACQUISITION_INSTRUMENT_VENDOR.description: Manufacturer of the mass spectrometer (e.g., Bruker, Waters, Thermo).

ANALYTE_ACQUISITION_ORDER.description: 1-based order of this run within a sequential multi-analyte session on the same tissue section. Recommended; required when multiple analyte classes are acquired from one section.

ANALYTE_CLASS.description: Molecular class(es) targeted by the acquisition. One or more values may be specified (e.g., a sequential metabolites/glycans/peptides workflow records each class).

CALIBRANT_MASSES.description: Comma-separated list of calibrant m/z values used (e.g., "622.0290, 922.0098").

FILENAME.description: Name of the file. Must end with .imzML

FILE_FORMAT.description: Format of the file; imzML (continuous/profile) at Level 1

HTAN_PARENT_ID.description: HTAN Parent ID(s) - Foreign key(s) to parent entity (B for Biospecimen, D for data file). One or more IDs; for aggregated files provide multiple. Each ID must have B or D suffix. Supports HTA200-229 for phase 2.

IBD_FILE_UUID.description: UUID embedded in the .imzML XML linking to the paired .ibd binary file. Accepts canonical hyphenated or 32-hex form, case-insensitive, with optional enclosing braces.

ION_MOBILITY.description: Whether ion mobility separation was applied during acquisition.

IS_TARGETED.description: Whether acquisition targets a pre-specified set of molecules (true) or is untargeted (false).

MASS_RESOLVING_POWER.description: Mass resolving power (m/delta-m) of the instrument. May be non-integer (e.g., 140000.5) and can exceed 1e6 on FTICR/Orbitrap.

MASS_TO_CHARGE_RANGE_HIGH_VALUE.description: Upper m/z boundary of the acquisition range.

MASS_TO_CHARGE_RANGE_LOW_VALUE.description: Lower m/z boundary of the acquisition range.

MASS_TO_CHARGE_RESOLVING_POWER.description: m/z value at which MASS_RESOLVING_POWER is specified. Recommended.

MATRIX_DEPOSITION_METHOD.description: Method used to apply the matrix to tissue. Conditionally required for MALDI-family techniques (MALDI, MALDI_2, IR_MALDESI).
MATRIX_DEPOSITION_METHOD.title: MatrixDepositionMethodEnum

MS_IONIZATION_TECHNIQUE.description: Ionization technique used. For timsTOF Flex, distinguish MALDI from MALDI_2.
MS_IONIZATION_TECHNIQUE.title: MsIonizationTechniqueEnum

MS_SCAN_MODE.description: Scan mode of the mass analyser (TOF-specific; NOT_APPLICABLE for non-TOF analysers).
MS_SCAN_MODE.title: MsScanModeEnum

PASSED_QC.description: Whether the file passed post-acquisition quality control at Level 1.

PIXEL_SIZE_X_UM.description: Pixel pitch in the X dimension (micrometers); corresponds to PSI-MS CV MS:1000042.

PIXEL_SIZE_Y_UM.description: Pixel pitch in the Y dimension (micrometers); corresponds to PSI-MS CV MS:1000043.

PREPARATION_INSTRUMENT_MODEL.description: Model of the matrix deposition instrument. Conditionally required for MALDI-family techniques (MALDI, MALDI_2, IR_MALDESI).

PREPARATION_INSTRUMENT_VENDOR.description: Manufacturer of the matrix deposition instrument. Conditionally required for MALDI-family techniques (MALDI, MALDI_2, IR_MALDESI).

PREPARATION_MATRIX.description: Matrix compound applied to the tissue section. Conditionally required for MALDI-family techniques (MALDI, MALDI_2, IR_MALDESI); use OTHER for IR-MALDESI (ice/endogenous-water matrix). Set NOT_APPLICABLE for non-matrix modalities (DESI, SIMS).
PREPARATION_MATRIX.title: PreparationMatrixEnum

PRE_ACQUISITION_TREATMENT.description: Enzymatic or chemical treatment applied to the section prior to this acquisition run. Recommended.
PRE_ACQUISITION_TREATMENT.title: PreAcquisitionTreatmentEnum

PROTOCOL_LINK.description: URL or DOI of the tissue preparation and matrix deposition protocol (e.g., protocols.io link). Recommended. Re-specified at each level.

SOFTWARE_AND_VERSION.description: Name and version of the acquisition software used to collect data (e.g., flexImaging 7.0, timsControl 5.1). Re-specified at each level.

SPECTRUM_TYPE.description: Spectral representation type. Level 1 is always PROFILE (continuous/profile imzML); the range enum permits only PROFILE, so this is enforced at the schema level.
SPECTRUM_TYPE.title: SpectrumTypeEnum

TIME_SINCE_ACQUISITION_INSTRUMENT_CALIBR.description: Elapsed time since the last instrument mass calibration. May be fractional (e.g., 1.5 hours); pair with TIME_SINCE_ACQUISITION_INSTRUMENT_CALIBRATION_UNIT.

title: MassSpectrometryImagingLevel1
